_comment: v5.0 Part 1 — PMTiles source registry for Daxelo Kinrel map.
_comment_2: ARCHITECTURE CHANGE (v5.0 Part 1, updated v7.0): The Flutter app no longer reads this file at runtime. PMTiles is now OPT-IN via `--dart-define=PMTILES_URL=https://.../archive.pmtiles` at build time. When that define is NOT passed (the default), the bundled kinrel_dark_style.json uses OpenFreeMap via its TileJSON endpoint (`https://tiles.openfreemap.org/planet`) — MapLibre follows the TileJSON to discover the current weekly-versioned tile path automatically. When the PMTiles define IS passed, the runtime HTTP probe verifies reachability before MapLibre fetches tiles — failed probes fall back to OpenFreeMap automatically. This file is kept as a human-readable registry of which PMTiles archives exist and where they live, but the `active` field below is NOT read by the app.
_comment_3: Pre-v5.0 history: this file was the source of truth, but the app never actually read it — the constant `_kPmtilesSourceUrl` in family_map_screen.dart was hardcoded to a localhost default. That mismatch caused the v5.0 Part 1 black-screen incident. See `worklog.md` at repo root, task v5.0-part1 (and v7.0 for the latest fix).
